title: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan
text:
Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

['From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Patel <lisa.patel@contoso.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

Hi Lisa —

Great talking earlier this week. As discussed, we’re ready to start the formal onboarding for Azure co-sell and the Partner Center referral flow. I put together a short plan to get Contoso listed in the marketplace and to map your field sellers to the accounts that will be in scope for co-sell. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm the list of primary Contoso field sellers who will be co-selling (name + email).
- Share any existing account-owner mapping (SFDC or CSV) you already use for enterprise accounts.
- Approve a mutual action plan (MAP) for listing assets, PCI/security metadata, and the co-sell enablement checklist.

I’ve attached a one-page readiness checklist and a blank account stitch CSV to speed up mapping. Jordan and Ben are on the thread; Jordan will lead the marketplace listing and Ben will coordinate the seller enablement playbook.

Proposed timeline: 2 business days to validate owners -> 1 week to complete listing metadata -> co-sell opt-in request to Azure Partner Ops. If that sounds ok, can you send the owner mapping by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks —

Priya Natarajan
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace & Co-sell)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: marketplace-listing-readiness-checklist.pdf (PDF), contoso-account-stitch.csv (CSV)', 'From: Lisa Patel <lisa.patel@contoso.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bridget O'Neill <bridget.oneill@contoso.com>, Azure Partner Ops <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

Priya —

Thanks for the clear plan. Bridget (CC’d) is our GTM lead and will own the seller roster. I’m attaching the most recent account-owner export; it’s not perfect but should be a good starting point. A couple of notes: 

- We have two regional seller pools in the US (East/West) and one national AE that covers strategic accounts.
- A subset of accounts are in a separate negotiated procurement process — should we mark those as "procurement_pending" in the CSV?

We can get you the cleaned owner mapping by end of day Tuesday. Also tagging Azure Partner Ops to let them know we’ll be initiating the referral opt-in next week.

Regards,
Lisa Patel
Senior Director, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso
Attachments: contoso-account-export-20261212.csv (CSV)

> Hi Lisa —
> 
> Great talking earlier this week...', 'From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Azure Partner Ops <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

Lisa / team —

Thanks for the export, Lisa. I pulled the file into our mapping template and started a sanity pass. A few quick flags I found: 

- Several enterprise accounts use alias domains (e.g., contoso-enterprise.com) and the export has inconsistent canonical names. I normalized these in contoso-account-stitch.csv attached.
- I added a column "procurement_state" and set your flagged accounts to procurement_pending; that will carry through to the MAP.
- For co-sell opt-in, Azure requires a confirmed field seller email for each mapped account. Rows without an email I marked as "needs_owner_confirm".

Next steps from our side: Jordan will package the marketplace metadata template; Ben will draft a short enablement note for seller outreach. Once you return the confirmed owners we’ll request Partner Center referral enrollment.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: contoso-account-stitch.csv (CSV)', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Patel <lisa.patel@contoso.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

All —

Couple of operational asks from the seller alignment perspective: 

1) For accounts that have multiple potential AEs, can Contoso indicate a primary and secondary seller? Azure PC prefers a single primary for referral routing.
2) For any accounts currently in procurement_pending, please confirm whether the AE should be blocked from co-sell outreach until procurement clears. That affects our outreach cadence.

I’ve attached a quick template (column: primary_seller_email, secondary_seller_email, procurement_hold) — if you can populate that along with the owner confirm list, Jordan and I will reconcile against Azure’s referral rules and prepare the opt-in request.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: owner-confirm-template.csv (CSV)', "From: Bridget O'Neill <bridget.oneill@contoso.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lisa Patel <lisa.patel@contoso.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Partner Ops <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T09:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell onboarding: marketplace listing readiness & account stitching plan

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the template. Quick answers: 

- We will provide primary and secondary seller emails in the owner-confirm-template.csv. Primary will be assigned where an AE has explicit quota ownership; otherwise we’ll set the national AE as primary.
- For procurement_pending accounts, please do not surface those to the seller pool until procurement clears — set procurement_hold = true.

Bridget will own the cleanup and will upload the completed CSV by tomorrow EOD. We also added two strategic accounts that need legal review before any listing metadata is public; we’ll flag those separately in the MAP.

Best,
Bridget O'Neill
GTM Lead, Strategic Accounts
Contoso

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Bridget/Lisa. Summary and next steps (MAP snapshot):

- Contoso to deliver completed owner-confirm-template.csv + cleaned account stitch CSV by 2026-12-15 EOD. (Bridget)
- Redwood: Jordan will prepare the marketplace metadata package and listing draft; Vanessa will submit normalized account CSV to Azure Partner Ops as part of referral opt-in. (Jordan / Vanessa)
- Karthik/Ben: Hold seller outreach for procurement_pending accounts; prepare enablement email for primary sellers for opt-in guidance. (Ben / Karthik)
- Legal review: Contoso to flag two strategic accounts that need legal clearance before any public listing. (Lisa)

I’ve attached a working MAP (mutual-action-plan-RW-Contoso.xlsx) and included the Drive link in related_links. Once Bridget uploads the completed CSV we’ll run a reconciliation and then submit the Partner Center referral enrollment request.

If there are no objections I’ll schedule the initial listing review with Azure Partner Ops for next Wednesday (2026-12-21) at 10am PT.

Thanks all —

Priya Natarajan
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace & Co-sell)
Redwood Inference
